messages:
eva_support: heads up — multiple GH Actions jobs started failing this morning with 401 from the Redwood API when using the gha-runner proxy. started ~08:10 UTC, ~50% of runs.
kai_infra: any error snippets? stack or token logs?
ci-runner-bot: failed job log: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\ncontent-type: application/json\n{\"error\":\"unauthorized\",\"detail\":\"token audience mismatch\"}`\n(we emit the decoded JWT in runner debug mode)
ci-runner-bot: decoded JWT aud claim: `repo:acme/short-repo-name` but the API expects `https://api.redwood.ai/instances/runner/acme/short-repo-name` — looks truncated.
eva_support: that aud looks wrong — it used to be the full URL. when did that change?
morgan_platform: rolling change yesterday to a lightweight OIDC header compress middleware on the proxy to reduce header size for huge monorepos. suspected it strips the url prefix if length > 32 chars. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
kai_infra: ack. repro steps — run locally with runner debug: `GHA_RUNNER_DEBUG=1 ./runner --emit-jwt` then inspect token aud. I can try to repro in staging.
morgan_platform: quick workaround: set env RUNNER_OIDC_AUD_OVERRIDE to the full expected aud -> proxy will pass it through without compression.
eva_support: customer workaround pinged — telling them to add override for now. need a permanent fix.
kai_infra: logs from runner show this snippet when building JWT:\n```\niss: \"https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com\"\nsub: \"repo:acme/short-repo-name:ref:refs/heads/main\"\naud: \"repo:acme/short-repo-name\"\nexp: 1710000000\n```\nthen the proxy rewrites aud to compressed token `r:acme/short-repo` before sending to Redwood auth endpoint.
ci-runner-bot: example failing request header (masked): `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`\nresponse from auth-service: `{\"ok\": false, \"code\": 401, \"msg\": \"aud claim not recognized\"}`
kai_infra: root cause likely the compressing middleware + our token audience validation tightened in last week's ACL PR (now rejects non-absolute auds). we merged a stricter check: require aud startswith `https://api.redwood.ai/`.
morgan_platform: plan: revert compression for OIDC tokens and add unit test for aud passthrough. will open PR now.
morgan_platform: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/platform/merge_requests/412 — patch disables compression for header "x-oidc-jwt" and adds test.
kai_infra: nice. ops question — do we need to rotate any keys? tokens already rejected, not leaked. no rotation needed, just fix proxy and restart runners.
eva_support: customer impact — several CI runs red. I posted status to customer slack and set expectation "workaround + config change, full fix by deploy in 2 hrs". they asked for logs for their security team.
kai_infra: attach small sanitized log for customer: see below (no secrets):\n```\n[2026-03-17T08:12:03Z] runner: building jwt aud=repo:acme/short-repo-name\n[2026-03-17T08:12:03Z] proxy: compress-aud -> r:acme/short-repo\n[2026-03-17T08:12:03Z] auth: validate aud -> fail (expected prefix https://api.redwood.ai/)\n[2026-03-17T08:12:04Z] auth: respond 401\n```\nmorgan_platform: will roll a hotfix to staging in 15m and then can roll to prod after smoke tests. I'll coordinate with deploy-bot for a config restart.
deploy-bot: scheduled restart: platform-proxy group, window start 08:35 UTC, rolling 3 instances.
eva_support: thx all — I'll update the ticket and loop in the account manager. once hotfix is live, I'll ask customer to retry and confirm.
ci-runner-bot: follow-up note: add acceptance test to gha-runner that asserts aud length/prefix preserved through proxy in CI matrix to prevent regressions.
kai_infra: adding a small alert to SLO dashboard to trigger if >5% CI run failures due to 401 auth for next 24h.
morgan_platform: PR merged to main -> will cherry-pick to release branch and ship hotfix.
eva_support: marking this thread resolved for now — reopen if we see failures after the restart. :white_check_mark:
